title: QUIC RFC 9000 Transport Parameter Connection ID Authentication Verification
verification_method: Focused S7P3 requirement-home tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers RFC 9000 Section 7.3 connection-ID transport-parameter authentication for codec preservation, role-specific server-only parameter boundaries, binding validation, runtime commit-path enforcement, and zero-length connection-ID parameter handling.
expected_result: The requirement-home tests show that connection-ID transport parameters carry the endpoint-selected values, missing required connection-ID binding parameters are rejected, mismatched values are rejected, matching values are accepted, server-only parameters cannot be emitted by clients, and zero-length selected connection IDs are encoded and validated as empty values rather than treated as absent. The runtime proof shows peer transport-parameter commit accepts matching zero-length initial_source_connection_id and closes with TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR when that required empty value is omitted.
procedure: Run the focused S7P3 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The S7P2 first-flight and server-adoption floors establish the handshake connection IDs supplied to the S7P3 validator.
The managed TLS bridge stages peer transport parameters before runtime commit.
Null transport-parameter byte arrays mean absent values; empty arrays mean present zero-length values.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim Section 7.4 invalid-value handling, remembered 0-RTT transport-parameter validation, preferred-address migration, public connection-ID policy APIs, hosted interop readiness, or broader connection-ID lifecycle parity outside Section 7.3 connection-ID binding authentication.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S7P3 requirement-home filter passed 29/29, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P3-0001 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0332 trace_clean, SpecTrace core validation passed across 424 JSON artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,412/4,412 after synchronizing Retry token publication assertions in adjacent S17P2P5P1 tests and adding the S17P2P5P2/P3 Retry client-processing proof, and git diff --check passed.
